assertions_reviewed: Shuffled source nodes flatten to group/a/b/cash in depth-first order, depths 1/2/2/1.
Exact weights 0.6/0.15/0.45/0.4, path factors and zero rounding residual are asserted.
Non-unit sum fails without normalization; explicit normalization sums exactly to one.
Stable-key tie allocation, original weights/sum, changed input/result digest and idempotent normalization are asserted.
Zero, 0.99, negative and over-one sole-child weights remain invalid with no normalization adjustments.
Empty tree, missing parent, cycles, duplicate keys/order, empty groups, invalid children and nested/multiple cash fail with explicit issue codes.
Depth eight is valid; ninth factor yields depth_exceeded.
256 nodes accepted; 257 rejected before validation work.
Ambiguous ISIN mapping validates only with mapping_unresolved warning; unresolved mapping without supporting identifier/reason raises.
limitations: This domain test validates publication eligibility; actual publication is exercised by unresolved_persisted.

assertions_reviewed: Unknown/mismatched instrument/listing, overlapping selectors and invalid preferred listing are rejected.

Malformed kind/value combinations yield constraint_fields_invalid.

Unknown instrument/listing/node exclusion selectors and multiple selectors fail explicitly.
Stable-key added/name/weight and exclusion changes are ordered; effective-time change detected; both inputs preserved.
Reordering input tuple preserves digest, while effective time or reporting currency changes digest.
Generated rounded sibling sets explicitly normalize to exact total one and replay without adjustments or digest change.
Generated exact 18-place weights and precision 2..100 retain identical canonical validation under reversed input order.
Generated depths 1..8 retain original factors, exact 160-context product quantized to 1e-18 and disclosed residual conserving total one.
Persisted explicit normalization advances revision and publishes digest bound to validation.
Direct published node-weight and version-effective-time UPDATEs fail; clone has new identity and equal content; audit includes create/update/publish/activate.
Direct SQL DELETE of published nodes and version independently raises publication-guard SQLSTATE23514.
After each rolled-back transaction the full published view, content and digest remain unchanged.
Eight concurrent identical creates have one portfolio identity; changed-payload replay conflicts.
Exact metadata retry without If-Match returns prior result; stale new command rejects revision.
Foreign-owner target read yields NOT_FOUND; direct cross-owner account/node/connection mutations violate DB scope.
Clone requires source targets:read even when caller has targets:write and portfolio:read.
Future version stays scheduled before due; four concurrent activation attempts total exactly one and repeat returns zero.
Archiving active version exposes no fallback; previous version remains superseded.

assertions_reviewed: Persisted HTTP create/update/draft/validate/publish/compare/archive support exact retries and stable identity; changed payload/stale/missing preconditions reject.

Rejected requests create no command identity.
Explicit 18-place normalization returns changed digest and exact unit weight; subsequent edit invalidates old validation.
Latest validation follows result revision; clone requires read scope, preserves source content and records changed effective time.
